area.tripRules: Pickup is at the closest bus stop in your neighbourhood. Drop-off is at the nearest transit hub or another On-Demand neighbourhood stop.

notes: Zones have no names in the source layer (MAP_ID only) and the agency page has no zone map, so they are named Zone 1 to Zone 11. The layer is not linked from the agency page; re-check it (last edited Oct 5, 2026). Sunday end time conflicts between sources (6:15 p.m. vs 6 p.m.); 6 p.m. used. Late Night On-Demand is drawn as 255 stops from the City of Grande Prairie Transit Stops layer (https://services7.arcgis.com/2IF4itZw5lplW9PO/arcgis/rest/services/Transit/FeatureServer/9, 296 rows retrieved 2026-10-11, deduplicated by stop code and location).
